repository.name: @webex/plugin-encryption
repository.purpose: Public Cypher plugin registered as webex.cypher. It downloads an encrypted Webex attachment and decrypts it (resolving keyUri and JWE from the file URI or the options, then calling the internal encryption plugin's decryptScr and download), registers and unregisters the device through the internal device plugin behind a registered flag, and provides the main Webex bundle entry that loads the authorization and internal encryption plugins and applies memory-storage defaults.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-encryption package entry
public_interfaces.audience: applications, the CDN script (webex/umd/encryption.min.js), and the sample app
public_interfaces.notes: main is dist/webex.js, whose export is the Webex class. The types entry (dist/types/index.d.ts) declares the default export as Cypher, so TypeScript users see a different type.

public_interfaces.name: webex.cypher runtime methods
public_interfaces.audience: applications that open encrypted Webex attachments
public_interfaces.notes: keyUri and JWE come from the file URI query string, else from options. Only useFileService is forwarded, default false. A decryptScr failure is wrapped with a cause; a download failure is returned raw.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not an evidence source. README.md and developer-quickstart.md are retained consumer docs, not the behavioral authority (docs/adr/0001-migrate-readme-and-quickstart.md). For sibling packages, read their specification when one exists (webex-core, internal-plugin-device) and their code otherwise (internal-plugin-encryption).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log or persist keyUri, JWE, the SCR, or decrypted bytes.
negative_guidance.why: They are key material or plaintext content.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not forward extra options to the internal download without updating the module spec.
negative_guidance.why: Only useFileService is forwarded today and its default differs from the internal plugin's.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change error message text casually.
negative_guidance.why: Callers may match it, and the wrapped message embeds the original stack.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the method or error reference.
Do not assume register() and deregister() are safe to overlap.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec/cypher/index.ts.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example behavior of the unmocked WebexCore in src/webex.js. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
